purpose: fixed-panel retrospective sensitivity; not fRMA or clinical validation
probe_summary: median within-array PM percentile per manufacturer probeset
reference: arithmetic mean of training-only PM quantile grids
transform: log2 interpolated training target at each probeset median percentile; median uniquely mapped probesets per gene
classifier: StandardScaler then LogisticRegression C=1 l2 lbfgs max_iter=1000 class_weight=balanced
model_selection: none; historical fixed panels are conditional, not de novo nested selection
partitions: all archived outer folds for Task B and Task C; paired same-model joint-RMA baseline
external_representation: within-sample percentile ranks over locked shared uniquely annotated gene universe
external_policy: previously exposed retrospective evaluation, no outcome tuning
bootstrap: 1000 paired donor-cluster draws of repeat-averaged held-out probabilities; conditional on fitted models
